def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    spot_rate_short = 0.025  # 2-year spot rate
    spot_rate_long = 0.055   # 4-year spot rate
    period_short = 2
    period_long = 4

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    forward_rate = (
        ((1 + spot_rate_long) ** period_long)
        / ((1 + spot_rate_short) ** period_short)
    ) ** (1 / (period_long - period_short)) - 1

    answer = round(forward_rate * 100, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
